data.desc: Diebold Nixdorf, Incorporated (NYSE: DBD) automates, digitizes, and transforms the way people bank and shop. As a leading global technology and services partner to many of the world's top financial institutions and retailers, its integrated solutions connect digital and physical channels for consumers conveniently, securely, and efficiently. The company has a presence in more than 100 countries with approximately 20,000 employees worldwide. Visit www.DieboldNixdorf.com for more information.
